Bandpass.Description: Built-in amplifier band pass 0.15 to 200 Hz, 1-pole, so no sharp corner at 200 Hz; amplitude roll-off function in ns_1k_1_300_filt.mat (fingerflex README (SDR zk881ps0522)).

TaskDescription: Cued individual finger flexion: subjects were cued with a word displayed on a bedside monitor indicating which finger to move during 2-second movement trials, performed self-paced movements (typically 2-5 per trial), each followed by a 2-second rest trial (blank screen); 30 movement cues per finger, interleaved randomly. Finger positions were recorded with a 5 degree-of-freedom dataglove (5DT, Irvine, CA); the glove signal is not included in this BIDS subset. (fingerflex README; Miller et al. 2012 PLoS Comput Biol doi:10.1371/journal.pcbi.1002655)
